policy.missing_city: Unknown city or invalid data resolves to null; the scene keeps its bounded generic fallback instead of inventing an identity.
policy.same_label_association: The existing guide uses the same city/commandery label; the ROM city-name glyphs have not been independently joined to all indices. A same-label association is not certified original-to-modern city identity.

references.role: Literal source labels only; not a positional join.
